cloud.title: Nimly account
cloud.description: Sign in with the account you use in the official app.

location.title: Location
location.description: Choose which location to expose in Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the vendor cloud.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often to ask the account for new activity. Shorter is more responsive and asks more of the vendor's API.

pin_required_remote.name: Cloud PIN required for remote unlock

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Ask the account for new activity right now.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which account to refresh. Leave out for all of them.

fetch_history.name: Fetch activity history
fetch_history.description: Return the activities Home Assistant has collected, newest first.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Limit the result to one lock.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of activities to return.

set_lock.name: Lock or unlock through the cloud
set_lock.description: An optional second control path. The local path is faster and keeps working without internet.

locked.name: Locked
locked.description: True to lock, false to unlock.

gateway_scan.name: Open the bridge pairing window
gateway_scan.description: Asks the bridge to accept a new device, so a module or an emulator can join from Home Assistant.

start.name: Start
start.description: True to open the window, false to close it.

probe.name: Call the vendor API (diagnostics)
probe.description: Calls paths on the vendor API and returns the status and a redacted body. Used to map the API; not needed for normal use.

paths.name: Paths
paths.description: Paths relative to the API root, or objects with path, method, json and headers.
